problem: A,B,C,D = construct_eq_trapezoid_q(8,4,2*pi/3), E = construct_on_tline(D,C,A), E = construct_angle_clockwise(C,D,pi/6)
necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_eq_trapezoid_q(8,4,2*pi/3), E = construct_on_tline(D,C,A), E = construct_angle_clockwise(C,D,pi/6)
proof:
Solution:
1. Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Angle_A_D_C + Angle_B_A_D - pi
2. Angle_A_D_C + Angle_B_A_D - pi & Angle_B_A_D - 2*pi/3 => Angle_A_D_C - pi/3
3. Angle_A_D_C - pi/3 & Angle_D_C_E - pi/6 => Angle_A_D_C + Angle_D_C_E - pi/2
4. Angle_A_D_C + Angle_D_C_E - pi/2 => Perpendicular(A,D,C,E)
5. Perpendicular(A,C,D,E) & Perpendicular(A,D,C,E) => Orthocenter(A,C,D,E)
6. Orthocenter(A,C,D,E) => Perpendicular(A,E,C,D)
7. Perpendicular(A,E,C,D) & Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Perpendicular(A,B,A,E)
8. Perpendicular(A,B,A,E) => Angle_B_A_E - pi/2
9. Angle_B_A_C + Angle_B_A_E - Angle_C_A_E & Angle_A_D_C + Angle_B_A_D - pi & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_A_C_E - Angle_D_C_E & Angle_B_A_C - Angle_B_A_D + Angle_C_A_D & Angle_D_C_E - pi/6 & Angle_A_C_E + Angle_A_E_C + Angle_C_A_E - pi & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_A_D_C + Angle_C_A_D - pi => Angle_A_E_C + Angle_B_A_E - 5*pi/6
10. Angle_B_A_E - pi/2 & Angle_A_E_C + Angle_B_A_E - 5*pi/6 => Angle_A_E_C - pi/3
